items.subject: equipment_cleaning_and_sanitization
items.statement: Equipment cleaning and sanitization procedure with verification, environmental monitoring, batch record review, cleaning execution, parameter recording, sample collection, deviation reporting, and equipment cleanup.
items.supporting_quote: 5.1 Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits. 5.2 Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification. 5.3 Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations. 5.4 Perform equipment cleaning and sanitization according to the approved batch record instructions. 5.5 Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time. 5.6 Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing. 5.7 Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-3803-78. 5.8 Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-5010-30.
